verdict: Ads are spending and generating intent — but leads aren't being captured.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your campaigns spent $1,450.96 and Google Ads recorded 14 conversions, yet zero leads are showing in tracked reporting — lead attribution is broken and is being repaired now. At the same time, your Google Business Profile generated 107 actions including 38 calls this period, meaning real customer intent is coming in through organic local search. The concern is that those inbound contacts are not being reliably captured, likely because the intake process has a gap following the staffing change in July. We are confirming intake ownership and auditing the automation routes this week so no inbound goes unanswered. Once attribution and intake are both confirmed, you should see lead counts reflect what the activity data already suggests is happening.

highlights.phrase: conversions recorded by Google Ads this period — none yet visible in lead tracking due to an attribution issue being fixed
calls driven by your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days, showing strong organic local demand
total ad spend this period, with erratic daily pacing being reviewed to stabilize delivery

watch_item.issue: Lead intake has a gap — 74 contacts and 40 opportunities are in the CRM this period, but zero appointments were booked, pointing to automation routes that may not have an active owner receiving them.
watch_item.fix: Intake ownership is being confirmed by August 31, and the automated follow-up sequences are being audited this week to ensure every inbound contact reaches a live person.
